meta.title: Install Donkey
meta.description: Download Donkey for macOS and install it with the standard drag-to-Applications flow.

title:
Install Donkey

on your Mac.
body: Your projects stay on your Mac. Text-to-speech and exports run locally, so your files never leave your computer until you’re ready to share them.

open.title: Open
open.body: Open the Donkey.dmg file from your downloads.
open.imageAlt: Donkey disk image download complete in a browser download tray.

install.title: Install
install.body: Drag and drop the Donkey app into your Applications folder.
install.imageAlt: Donkey app icon being dragged into the Applications folder.

launch.title: Launch
launch.body: Open Donkey from your Applications folder or Launchpad.
launch.imageAlt: Donkey app icon in the macOS Dock.
